name: Vélez-Málaga (Spain)
description: Square green banner (pendón) edged on three sides with a gold brocade border, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Vélez-Málaga (a king on horseback before a city on green).
history: The official symbols of Vélez-Málaga are its banner (pendón) and its arms; the banner is square, 157.5 by 157.5 centimetres, of green cloth edged with a band of gold thread brocade on three of its edges.
